question: Does selective delegation improve reliability and computational efficiency while preserving replenishment performance?

arms.fixed_agents: LangGraph fixed path: fresh supplier, coordinator and critic calls on every day; original prompts and model settings
arms.selective_agents: LangGraph conditional path: strict table parser or supplier LLM; explicit event-policy router; deterministic release gate; LLM review only when checks fail
arms.structured_planner: Same tool and event-policy mapping with authenticated structured supplier fields; no LLM

failure_policy: Hold failed or unknown conditions; record review request; never substitute a comparator action

simulation.initial_stock: ceil(3 * past-56-day mean); no initial pipeline; common per matched case
simulation.demand: Published evaluation sales proxy times independent mean-one lognormal factor (sigma=.10); promotion multiplies day 2 onward by 1.3
simulation.promotion_knowledge: Announced multiplier is available equally before affected decisions; no realised future demand shown
simulation.supplier_disruption: Day 2 onward: double cartons and MOQ, add one delivery day, reduce capacity 30%; current terms available equally
simulation.suppliers: Three synthetic groups, ten series each; not publisher supplier observations
simulation.budget_and_capacity: Training-derived 2.8x historical mean; current daily +/-8% announced variation; unit purchase cost 1
simulation.supply: Opportunity-keyed: 2% cancellation, 10% 80% fill, 10% extra-day delay; same draws for matched arms
simulation.shelf_life: M5 nonperishable within horizon; RetailNet hypothetical 3-day FIFO
simulation.planning: Standard policy z=1.28. Tool z=1.28 balanced or 1.65 for promotion; MILP minimises purchase + weighted target shortfall, with hard budget/capacity/pack/MOQ limits
simulation.primary_cost: Inventory operating cost index = .02 * closing stock + 5 * unmet demand + expired units, summed over seven days
simulation.purchase_spend: Reported separately; not added to primary operating cost to avoid double-counting acquisition and expiry
simulation.economics: Synthetic dimensionless cost index; not retailer profit or real monetary ROI

shared_forecast.training: Past-only panel, at most 365 days; recursive 14-day prediction; no evaluation outcomes as model inputs
shared_forecast.uncertainty: Standard deviation of training weekly sales differences / sqrt(2); not evaluation residuals

hypotheses.A1: Selective workflow uses at least 50% fewer native model calls than the fixed workflow
hypotheses.A2: Selective workflow has lower mean decision latency in each dataset
hypotheses.A3: Selective workflow preserves or improves declared-policy accuracy with no committed-action violations in each dataset
hypotheses.A4: Selective workflow preserves performance: lower paired fill bound above -0.10 percentage points and upper paired cost bound below +0.5%
hypotheses.A5_exploratory: Any inventory-performance gain is attributable to explicit policy routing rather than a better numerical planner

success_rule: A1-A4 all assessed; do not require or claim service/cost superiority if uncertainty does not establish it
paired_order: Alternate fixed/selective execution order with seed+day parity; structured comparator remains common
inference: 30 paired simulation seeds; origins aggregated within seed, scenarios equally weighted; 10,000 bootstrap resamples

prompts.supplier: You are the supplier-information agent. Read the current supplier message. Extract exactly one rule for each of S1, S2 and S3, and the daily budget. Copy every number exactly; pack is carton size, moq is minimum order, lead_days is delivery time, capacity is daily dispatch limit. Meaning matters, not the order of numbers in the sentence: a dispatch limit is capacity, and cartons of N means pack=N. Do not swap these fields. Use the current rules only. Return only the JSON object.
prompts.planner: You are the replenishment coordination agent. Numerical tools calculate quantities. Request constrained_order. Select balanced for routine trading and supplier disruption. Select service_first for an active announced promotion when availability is the priority. Do not estimate quantities yourself. Return only JSON.
prompts.critic: You are the independent review agent. Approve only when source verification, tool routing, solver feasibility, and every listed action check pass. Hold if any check fails or is unknown. Never override a failed check. Return only JSON.

supplier.content: For S1, dispatch no more than 97 units today; allow 2 days for delivery. Minimum order 6 units; cartons of 3. For S2, cartons contain 4 units, minimum order 8, delivery 1 day, dispatch limit 88. S3 has dispatch limit 120, delivery 3 days, minimum order 12, carton size 6. Daily spending budget 250.

limitations: 30 selected series per dataset, not all 50K RetailNet series
Two historical test weeks per dataset; RetailNet includes one rolling training-file holdout and the official evaluation week
Historical evaluation periods were used in earlier work; fresh execution does not make them unseen research holdouts
Controlled supplier messages, simulated inventories and supply; no retailer deployment or measured staff time
Structured planner is a strong idealised comparator with already-structured current rules; manual entry time not measured
Any advantage over conventional ordering can include the numerical tool; the structured comparator isolates that contribution
Source verification compares LLM extraction with authenticated current contract fields; those fields contain no future demand
One small deterministic pretrained LLM; no generalisation to other models claimed
Architecture motivated by previously inspected diagnostics; new simulation seeds do not make historical weeks unseen
No measured employee review; malformed-input handling checked separately, not injected into primary sales simulations
One small pretrained model; fewer calls reflect deterministic delegation, not improved model weights
Latency uses the same warmed local server with counterbalanced arm order; token-prefix optimisations may affect timing
